greek: Ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Δινα ἡ θυγάτηρ Λειας, ἣν ἔτεκεν τῷ Ιακωβ, καταμαθεῖν τὰς θυγατέρας τῶν ἐγχωρίων.
hint: And Dinah, Leah's daughter, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to get to know the daughters of the inhabitants.

notes.text: ἐγχώριος, *in* or *of the country*, and as a noun *a dweller in the land, inhabitant*: the noun sense heads it, as with ἡ περίχωρος at 13:10.
καταμανθάνω, *to observe well*, as at 24:21; the aorist infinitive of purpose.

reading: [[went out of|went out of, came out, went away and marched off, went forth|ἐξέρχομαι]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Δινα]] the daughter of [[name:Λειας]], which [[brought into the world|brought into the world, brought forth, bore, produced|τίκτω]] to [[name:Ιακωβ]], [[to observe well|to observe well, to examine closely, to learn thoroughly, to perceive and understand, to discover and find, to consider|καταμανθάνω]] the daughters [[of the dwellers in the land|of the dwellers in the land, of the inhabitants, of the ones in and of the country, of the ones according to the custom of the country|ἐγχώριος]].

names.gloss: (Λεια, from Hebrew Lēʾâ, of uncertain meaning, perhaps "wild cow")
(Ιακωβ, from Hebrew Yaʿăqōb, which the Hebrew of 25:26 hears in ʿāqēb, "heel")

greek: καὶ εἶδεν αὐτὴν Συχεμ ὁ υἱὸς Εμμωρ ὁ Χορραῖος ὁ ἄρχων τῆς γῆς καὶ λαβὼν αὐτὴν ἐκοιμήθη μετʼ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐταπείνωσεν αὐτήν.
hint: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Horite, the ruler of the land, saw her, and took her and lay with her and humbled her.

notes.text: ταπεινόω, *to lower*, as at 15:13 and 31:50; the Greek has no word of force here beyond it.
[[flag]] The Hebrew reads *the Hivite*; the Greek has *the Horite*, as at 36:20.

reading: and [[saw|saw, perceived, beheld, looked at|ὁράω]] her [[name:Συχεμ]] the son of [[name:Εμμωρ]] the [[name:Χορραῖος]] [[the ruler|the ruler, the commander, the chief, the captain, the chief magistrate|ἄρχων]] [[of the earth|of the earth, of the land, of the ground|γῆ]] and [[having taken|having taken, having received, having taken hold of and grasped and seized|λαμβάνω]] her [[fell asleep|fell asleep, went abed and lay abed, slept, fell asleep and died, kept watch at night|κοιμάω]] [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of|μετά + genitive]] of her and [[lowered|lowered, lessened, disparaged, humbled and abased, made lowly and humbled|ταπεινόω]] her.

names.gloss: (Συχεμ, from Hebrew Šĕkem, "shoulder", the man who bears the city's name)
(Χορραῖος, from Hebrew Ḥōrî, usually connected with ḥōr, "hole, cave")

greek: καὶ προσέσχεν τῇ ψυχῇ Δινας τῆς θυγατρὸς Ιακωβ καὶ ἠγάπησεν τὴν παρθένον καὶ ἐλάλησεν κατὰ τὴν διάνοιαν τῆς παρθένου αὐτῇ.
hint: And he clung to the soul of Dinah the daughter of Jacob and loved the girl and spoke to her according to the girl's mind.

notes.text: προσέχω, *to hold to*, as at 4:5; with the dative it is the whole of what English calls clinging.
παρθένος, *a maid*, as at 24:14; the word says her state, not her age.

reading: and [[held to|held to, offered, brought to, turned to, turned the mind to, gave heed to|προσέχω]] [[to the breath|to the breath, to the life, to the spirit, to life and death, to the ghost, to the departed soul|ψυχή]] of [[name:Δινας]] of the daughter of [[name:Ιακωβ]] and [[treated with affection|treated with affection, caressed, loved, was fond of, regarded with brotherly love, was well pleased and contented with, was content|ἀγαπάω]] [[the maid|the maid, the maiden, the virgin, the girl|παρθένος]] and [[talked|talked, chatted, prattled, babbled, said, talked of, spoke, chattered, chirped|λαλέω]] [[down|down, downwards, down from, down upon, over, upon|κατά + accusative]] [[the thought|the thought, the intention and purpose, the notion and opinion, the intelligence and understanding, the meaning|διάνοια]] [[of the maid|of the maid, of the maiden, of the virgin, of the girl|παρθένος]] to her.

greek: εἶπεν δὲ Συχεμ πρὸς Εμμωρ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ λέγων Λαβέ μοι τὴν παιδίσκην ταύτην εἰς γυναῖκα.
hint: And Shechem said to Hamor his father: Get me this young woman for a wife.

notes.text: Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Συχεμ]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Εμμωρ]] [[the father|the father, the grandfather|πατήρ]] of him [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]] [[take|take, receive, take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] to me [[the young girl|the young girl, the maiden, the young slave, the courtesan|παιδίσκη]] [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[a woman|a woman, a mistress and lady, a wife and spouse, a mortal woman|γυνή]].

greek: Ιακωβ δὲ ἤκουσεν ὅτι ἐμίανεν ὁ υἱὸς Εμμωρ Διναν τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ· οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἦσαν μετὰ τῶν κτηνῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ, παρεσιώπησεν δὲ Ιακωβ ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν αὐτούς.
hint: And Jacob heard that the son of Hamor had defiled Dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the plain, and Jacob kept silent until they came.

notes.text: μιαίνω, properly *to stain, dye*, then *to defile*; the word is of staining, not of violence.
παρασιωπάω, one sense, *to pass over in silence*, as at 24:21.

reading: [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[heard|heard, had hearing of, heard tell of, hearkened and gave ear, listened to and obeyed|ἀκούω]] [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] [[stained|stained, dyed, defiled and sullied, tainted and defiled|μιαίνω]] the son of [[name:Εμμωρ]] [[name:Διναν]] the daughter of him; [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], the sons of him were, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one, [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of|μετά + genitive]] [[of the flocks and herds|of the flocks and herds, of the single beasts, of the beasts for riding|κτῆνος]] of him [[in the plain|within, inside of, and by means of the plain, the flat, the plain flat open country|ἐν; πεδίον]], passed over in silence [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[until|until, till, while, so long as|ἕως]] [[to come|to come, to go, to go back and return, to be going to and intend, to come within a little of and be near|ἔρχομαι]] them.

greek: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Εμμωρ ὁ πατὴρ Συχεμ πρὸς Ιακωβ λαλῆσαι αὐτῷ.
hint: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak to him.

notes.text: The aorist infinitive of purpose, as at 34:1.

reading: [[went out of|went out of, came out, went away and marched off, went forth|ἐξέρχομαι]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Εμμωρ]] [[the father|the father, the grandfather|πατήρ]] of [[name:Συχεμ]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[to talk|to talk, to chat, to prattle, to babble, to say, to talk of, to speak, to chatter, to chirp|λαλέω]] to him.

greek: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ιακωβ ἦλθον ἐκ τοῦ πεδίου· ὡς δὲ ἤκουσαν, κατενύχθησαν οἱ ἄνδρες, καὶ λυπηρὸν ἦν αὐτοῖς σφόδρα ὅτι ἄσχημον ἐποίησεν ἐν Ισραηλ κοιμηθεὶς μετὰ τῆς θυγατρὸς Ιακωβ, καὶ οὐχ οὕτως ἔσται.
hint: And the sons of Jacob came from the plain; and when they heard, the men were stung, and it was very painful to them, because he had done a shameful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter, and it shall not be so.

notes.text: κατανύσσω, *to stab, gouge*, in the passive of the mind, as at 27:38.
ἀσχήμων, *misshapen, unseemly*, the neuter as a noun; the Greek names the shape of the deed, not its guilt.
The future of εἰμί closing the verse: a rule stated, not a report of what was said.

reading: [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], the sons of [[name:Ιακωβ]] [[came|came, went, went back and returned, was going to and intended, came within a little of and was near|ἔρχομαι]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of the plain|of the plain, of the flat, of the plain flat open country|πεδίον]]; [[as|as, according as, considering, like|ὡς]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[heard|heard, had hearing of, heard tell of, hearkened and gave ear, listened to and obeyed|ἀκούω]], [[were sorely pricked|were sorely pricked, were stupefied and slumbered|κατανύσσω]] [[the men|the men, the men in the prime of life|ἀνήρ]], and [[painful|painful, distressing, causing sorrow, causing pain and troublesome and vexatious and offensive|λυπηρός]] was, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one, to them [[very|very, very much, exceedingly, violently, far, most certainly|σφόδρα]], [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] [[misshapen|misshapen, unseemly, shameful, indecorous|ἀσχήμων]] [[made|made, did, produced, created|ποιέω]] [[in|within, inside of, and by means of|ἐν]] [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[having fallen asleep|having fallen asleep, having gone abed and lain abed, having slept, having fallen asleep and died, having kept watch at night|κοιμάω]] [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of|μετά + genitive]] of the daughter of [[name:Ιακωβ]], and not [[in this way|in this way, in this manner, so, thus, even so, so much|οὕτως]] will be.

names.gloss: (Ισραηλ, from Hebrew Yiśrāʾēl, which the Hebrew of 32:29 hears in śārâ ʿim ʾĕlōhîm, "he strove with God")

greek: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Εμμωρ αὐτοῖς λέγων Συχεμ ὁ υἱός μου προείλατο τῇ ψυχῇ τὴν θυγατέρα ὑμῶν· δότε οὖν αὐτὴν αὐτῷ γυναῖκα.
hint: And Hamor spoke to them, saying: Shechem my son has chosen your daughter with his soul; give her to him for a wife.

notes.text: προαιρέω, *to bring forth from one's stores*, and in the middle *to take away first for oneself* and *to choose before, prefer*.
The dative of the soul, as at 34:3: the choosing is said to be done with it.

reading: and [[talked|talked, chatted, prattled, babbled, said, talked of, spoke, chattered, chirped|λαλέω]] [[name:Εμμωρ]] to them [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]] [[name:Συχεμ]] the son of me [[took away first for himself|took away first for himself, removed out of his way, chose before and preferred, preferred to do, purposed and proposed to do|προαιρέω]] [[to the breath|to the breath, to the life, to the spirit, to life and death, to the ghost, to the departed soul|ψυχή]] the daughter of you; [[give|give, grant, provide, give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] [[really|really, at all events, surely, so, then and therefore|οὖν]] her to him [[a woman|a woman, a mistress and lady, a wife and spouse, a mortal woman|γυνή]].

greek: ἐπιγαμβρεύσασθε ἡμῖν· τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν δότε ἡμῖν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ἡμῶν λάβετε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν.
hint: Make marriages with us: give us your daughters and take our daughters for your sons.

notes.text: ἐπιγαμβρεύω, one sense, *to marry as the next of kin*: the Greek is the word of the levirate, not of marriage generally.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus reads ἐπιγαμβρεύσατε, the active imperative.

reading: marry as the next of kin to us; the daughters of you [[give|give, grant, provide, give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] to us and the daughters of us [[take|take, receive, take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] to the sons of you.

greek: καὶ ἐν ἡμῖν κατοικεῖτε, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἰδοὺ πλατεῖα ἐναντίον ὑμῶν· κατοικεῖτε καὶ ἐμπορεύεσθε ἐπʼ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐγκτήσασθε ἐν αὐτῇ.
hint: And dwell among us, and behold the land is broad before you; dwell and trade in it and acquire property in it.

notes.text: πλατύς, *wide, broad*; the feminine with γῆ, as the printed page has it.
ἐγκτάομαι, one sense, *to acquire possessions in a foreign country*: the verb says they would be foreigners.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus reads ἐνκτᾶσθαι, the present infinitive, and puts ἰδού before ἡ γῆ.

reading: and [[in us|within, inside of, and by means of us|ἐν]] [[dwell in|dwell in, settle in, colonise, inhabit, settle and dwell, lie and be situate|κατοικέω]], and [[the earth|the earth, the land, the ground|γῆ]] [[lo|lo, behold, see there|ἰδού]] [[wide|wide, broad, flat and level, broad-shouldered, flat, a street, the flat of the hand, salt and brackish|πλατύς]] [[in the presence of|in the presence of, before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] of you; [[dwell in|dwell in, settle in, colonise, inhabit, settle and dwell, lie and be situate|κατοικέω]] and [[travel|travel, travel for traffic and be merchants and trade and traffic, import, make gain of and overreach|ἐμπορεύομαι]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] of her and acquire possessions in [[in her|within, inside of, and by means of her|ἐν]].

greek: εἶπεν δὲ Συχεμ πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτῆς καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῆς Εὕροιμι χάριν ἐναντίον ὑμῶν, καὶ ὃ ἐὰν εἴπητε, δώσομεν.
hint: And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers: Let me find favour before you, and whatever you say, we will give.

notes.text: The aorist optative, first singular: the wish standing on its own, without ἄν.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus adds ἡμῖν, *to us*.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Συχεμ]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[the father|the father, the grandfather|πατήρ]] of her and [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[the sons of the same mother|the sons of the same mother, the brothers, the near kinsmen|ἀδελφός]] of her [[may I find|may I find, may I find out, may I discover|εὑρίσκω]] [[outward grace|outward grace, favour, loveliness, graciousness and kindness and goodwill, thankfulness and thanks and gratitude, a favour and kindness and boon, a gratification and delight|χάρις]] [[in the presence of|in the presence of, before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] of you, and which ever [[you may say|you may say, you may speak, you may declare, you may call by name, you may tell|λέγω]] [[we will give|we will give, we will grant, we will provide, we will give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]].

greek: πληθύνατε τὴν φερνὴν σφόδρα, καὶ δώσω, καθότι ἂν εἴπητέ μοι, καὶ δώσετέ μοι τὴν παῖδα ταύτην εἰς γυναῖκα.
hint: Make the bride-price very great, and I will give as you say to me, and give me this girl for a wife.

notes.text: φερνή, *that which is brought by the wife*, the dowry; here it is paid the other way, by the bridegroom, as the Hebrew mōhar is.

reading: [[make full|make full, increase, multiply|πληθύνω]] [[that which is brought by the wife|that which is brought by the wife, the dowry and portion, the dower, the bridal gifts|φερνή]] [[very|very, very much, exceedingly, violently, far, most certainly|σφόδρα]], and [[I will give|I will give, I will grant, I will provide, I will give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]], in what manner ever [[you may say|you may say, you may speak, you may declare, you may call by name, you may tell|λέγω]] to me, and [[you will give|you will give, you will grant, you will provide, you will give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] to me [[the child|the child, the son, the daughter, the grandchild, the boy and youth and lad, the girl and maiden, the slave and servant and man and maid|παῖς]] [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[a woman|a woman, a mistress and lady, a wife and spouse, a mortal woman|γυνή]].

greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ Ιακωβ τῷ Συχεμ καὶ Εμμωρ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ μετὰ δόλου καὶ ἐλάλησαν αὐτοῖς, ὅτι ἐμίαναν Διναν τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν,
hint: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with guile and spoke to them, because they had defiled Dinah their sister,

notes.text: δόλος, *a bait*, as at 27:35, where Isaac says the same of Jacob.

reading: [[gave answer to|gave answer to, replied, answered, answered charges and defended themselves|ἀποκρίνομαι]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], the sons of [[name:Ιακωβ]] to [[name:Συχεμ]] and to [[name:Εμμωρ]] [[to the father|to the father, to the grandfather|πατήρ]] of him [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of|μετά + genitive]] [[of a bait|of a bait, of any cunning contrivance for deceiving and catching, of any trick, of a stratagem, of craft and cunning and treachery|δόλος]] and [[talked|talked, chatted, prattled, babbled, said, talked of, spoke, chattered, chirped|λαλέω]] to them, [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] [[stained|stained, dyed, defiled and sullied, tainted and defiled|μιαίνω]] [[name:Διναν]] the sister of them,

greek: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς Συμεων καὶ Λευι οἱ ἀδελφοὶ Δινας υἱοὶ δὲ Λειας Οὐ δυνησόμεθα ποιῆσαι τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο, δοῦναι τὴν ἀδελφὴν ἡμῶν ἀνθρώπῳ, ὃς ἔχει ἀκροβυστίαν· ἔστιν γὰρ ὄνειδος ἡμῖν.
hint: and Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, sons of Leah, said to them: We will not be able to do this thing, to give our sister to a man who has a foreskin; for it is a reproach to us.

notes.text: ἀκροβυστία, *the foreskin*, as at 17:11; the Greek word itself is unknown outside the Septuagint and what follows it.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus omits τὸ ῥῆμα.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] to them [[name:Συμεων]] and [[name:Λευι]] [[the sons of the same mother|the sons of the same mother, the brothers, the near kinsmen|ἀδελφός]] of [[name:Δινας]] sons [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], of [[name:Λειας]] not [[we will be able|we will be able, we will be capable, we will be strong enough, we will dare and bear, we will pass for, we will be worth, we will be equivalent to, we will signify and mean|δύναμαι]] [[to make|to make, to do, to produce, to create|ποιέω]] [[that which is said|that which is said and spoken, the word, the saying, the phrase, the subject of speech and the thing, the verb|ῥῆμα]] [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]], [[to give|to give, to grant, to provide, to give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] the sister of us [[to a man|to a man, to a human being, to mankind|ἄνθρωπος]], which [[has|has, holds, possesses, keeps, dwells in and inhabits, holds fast, bears up against and supports|ἔχω]] [[foreskin|foreskin, circumcision, uncircumcision, the uncircumcised|ἀκροβυστία]]; is [[for|for, since and as, for otherwise and else, now, but, why and what, would that|γάρ]] [[reproach|reproach, censure, blame, disgrace, matter of reproach|ὄνειδος]] to us.

names.gloss: (Συμεων, from Hebrew Šimʿôn, which the Hebrew of 29:33 hears in šāmaʿ, "he heard")
(Λευι, from Hebrew Lēwî, which the Hebrew of 29:34 hears in lāwâ, "he was joined")

greek: ἐν τούτῳ ὁμοιωθησόμεθα ὑμῖν καὶ κατοικήσομεν ἐν ὑμῖν, ἐὰν γένησθε ὡς ἡμεῖς καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν τῷ περιτμηθῆναι ὑμῶν πᾶν ἀρσενικόν,
hint: On this condition we will be made like you and dwell among you: if you become as we are, and you too are circumcised, every male of you,

notes.text: ὁμοιόω, *to make like*, in the passive *to be made like, become like*.
ἐν with the articular infinitive: the one construction where the article before an infinitive is printed here.

reading: [[in this|within, inside of, and by means of this, the nearer, what follows|ἐν; οὗτος]] [[we will be made like|we will be made like, we will be likened and compared, we will become like, we will be like|ὁμοιόω]] to you and [[we will dwell in|we will dwell in, we will settle in, we will colonise, we will inhabit, we will settle and dwell, we will lie and be situate|κατοικέω]] [[in you|within, inside of, and by means of you|ἐν]], if [[you may come to be|you may come to be, you may arise, you may be brought into existence|γίνομαι]] [[as|as, according as, considering, like|ὡς]] we and you [[in|within, inside of, and by means of|ἐν]] [[the being cut|the being cut, the being clipped round about, the being pruned, the being cut off, the being cut off and hemmed in all round, the being curtailed of, the being cut off and intercepted|περιτέμνω]] of you [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] male,

greek: καὶ δώσομεν τὰς θυγατέρας ἡμῶν ὑμῖν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων ὑμῶν λημψόμεθα ἡμῖν γυναῖκας καὶ οἰκήσομεν παρʼ ὑμῖν καὶ ἐσόμεθα ὡς γένος ἕν.
hint: and we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves as wives, and we will live beside you and be as one race.

notes.text: οἰκέω, *to inhabit*, beside κατοικέω in the verse before: the simple verb, not the compound.

reading: and [[we will give|we will give, we will grant, we will provide, we will give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] the daughters of us to you and [[from|from, away from, far from, apart from|ἀπό]] of the daughters of you [[we will take|we will take, we will receive, we will take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] to us [[women|women, mistresses and ladies, wives and spouses, mortal women|γυνή]] and [[we will inhabit|we will inhabit, we will occupy, we will dwell and live, we will be settled|οἰκέω]] [[beside|beside, alongside of, by, at, before, with|παρά + dative]] to you and we will be [[as|as, according as, considering, like|ὡς]] [[race|race, stock and family, offspring and posterity, a clan and house, a tribe and caste, a breed, an age and generation, sex and gender, a class and sort and kind, genus|γένος]] [[one|one, a single one, one alone|εἷς]].

greek: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ εἰσακούσητε ἡμῶν τοῦ περιτέμνεσθαι, λαβόντες τὰς θυγατέρας ἡμῶν ἀπελευσόμεθα.
hint: But if you do not listen to us and be circumcised, we will take our daughters and go away.

notes.text: The articular infinitive of the thing heard; the article is not printed, as at 34:5.

greek: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Ἀλλʼ ὡσεὶ πόρνῃ χρήσωνται τῇ ἀδελφῇ ἡμῶν;
hint: And they said: But shall they treat our sister like a harlot?

notes.text: χράομαι, *to use*, as at 12:16; the aorist subjunctive in a question, of what is not to be borne.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: the ones [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[otherwise|otherwise, but, except, yet, but then and however, but really and certainly|ἀλλά]] [[just as if|just as if, as though, about|ὡσεί]] [[to a harlot|to a harlot, to a prostitute|πόρνη]] [[they should use|they should use, they should have and use, they should indulge, they should experience and suffer and be subject to, they should come to, they should live under, they should make use of, they should treat, they should be intimate with, they should be in need and yearn after, they should have in use and possess|χράομαι]] to the sister of us;
